title: plan-bender config
description: Configuration for plan-bender (.plan-bender.json / .plan-bender.local.json). Three layers are deep-merged, later wins: ~/.config/plan-bender/defaults.json, then .plan-bender.json, then .plan-bender.local.json.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, used by editors for validation and autocomplete.

tracks.description: Planning tracks issues are organized into.

workflow_states.description: Ordered workflow states an issue moves through.

worktree_base.description: Base directory for git worktrees created during dispatch. Defaults to a sibling of the repo when unset.

max_points.description: Maximum points allowed on a single issue.

agents.description: Coding agents to install skills for. Each value is `true`/`false` to enable/disable with registry defaults, or an object for per-agent overrides.

branch_strategy.description: How implementation branches are managed. 'integration' merges issue branches into one feature branch; 'direct' commits to a single branch.

subprocess_timeout.description: Go duration string capping each agent subprocess (e.g. "30m", "1h30m"). Empty defaults to 30m.

max_parallel.description: Max agent subprocesses run concurrently in a batch.

linear.description: Linear integration. Put credentials in .plan-bender.local.json (gitignored). String values support $ENV_VAR expansion.

enabled.description: Enable syncing plans to Linear. Requires api_key and team.

team.description: Linear team id or key. Supports $ENV_VAR.

project_id.description: Linear project id to sync into.

status_map.description: Maps plan-bender workflow states to Linear status names.

hooks.description: Shell commands run at dispatch lifecycle points.

after_batch.description: Command run after a batch completes.

update_check.description: Check for new pb versions on run.

manage_gitignore.description: Let pb manage generated-skill entries in .gitignore.

review_with_user.description: Pause for human review during workflows.

report_bugs.description: Allow plan-bender to write bug/error report logs.

interview_with_docs.description: Include project docs when interviewing during planning.

no_implement.description: When true, skip generating the implementation skills (bender-implement-prd, bender-implement-hitl, bender-implement-issue). Existing generated copies are removed on the next setup/generate.

agentEntry.description: true/false to enable/disable with registry defaults, or an object of per-agent overrides.

enabled.description: Whether this agent is enabled. Defaults to true when the object form is used.

gitignore_pattern.description: Glob for generated skills added to .gitignore when manage_gitignore is on.

required.description: Whether the field is required on every issue.

enum_values.description: Allowed values when type is 'enum'. Required for enum fields.
